translationRepairs: There is large remainder is 0, and the small remainder is 24.
The large remainder is 0, and the small remainder is 24.

Focus unit 無大餘，小餘二十四 has a broken idiomatic (“There is large remainder is 0”); rendering 無大餘 as “the large remainder is 0” matches the chapter’s parallel treatment of 無小餘 as “the small remainder is 0,” and the proposed sentence is grammatical.
Zhu Li Xie Qiao, the fifth year.
Zhu Li Xie Qia, the fifth year.
祝犁協洽五年 has 協洽 = xiéqià; Qiao wrongly treats 洽 as 喬, but Xia is also wrong—qià romanizes as Qia in this chapter’s syllable style, so the idiomatic must be Xie Qia.
Zhu Li Xie Qiao fifth year.
Zhu Li Xie Qia fifth year.
The same 協洽 in the literal is misread as Qiao; the proposal’s Xia still mismatches qià, so revise to Xie Qia while keeping the rest of the calque.
Shang Heng Dun Tan, the first year of Jianzhao.
Shang Heng Tun Tan, the first year of Jianzhao.
商橫涒灘建昭元年 has 涒灘 = tūntān; Dun misreads 涒 (as if 敦), and Tun Tan restores the correct year-name reading without changing the rest of the sentence.
Shang Heng Dun Tan Jian Zhao first year.
Shang Heng Tun Tan Jian Zhao first year.
The literal likewise has Dun Tan for 涒灘; Tun Tan matches tūntān and leaves Jian Zhao first year intact.
Duameng Chi Fen Ruo, the first year of Jingning.
Duanmeng Chi Fen Ruo, the first year of Jingning.
端蒙赤奮若竟寧元年 begins with 端蒙 = Duānméng; Duameng drops the n, and Duanmeng restores the standard reading used for this year name.
Duameng Chi Fen Ruo Jing Ning first year.
Duanmeng Chi Fen Ruo Jing Ning first year.
The literal’s Duameng is the same omitted-n error for 端蒙; Duanmeng is the correct romanization and otherwise preserves the calque.
